title: Silicon Power XS70 2TB PCIe Gen 4 NVMe M.2 SSD $231.95 + Delivery @ Mwave
body:
Deal: Silicon Power XS70 2TB PCIe Gen 4 NVMe M.2 SSD $231.95 + Delivery @ Mwave

[kid-vhee] 1400 TBW for this model which is decent, but if past experiences are anything, my Silicon power SSD always had early failures or failed (most were 2.5" SSD which deterred me off them). Interestingly reddit reports these having two version of controllers, with the newer one experiencing higher failure rates.
Check your risk profile - non-essential, just RMA at this price point if you want to deal with headaches.
[Click_It] After a few failures from various brands I made the decision to go with Samsung Pro lineup and never had a failure again. Sure you pay for it but having a drive fail is not worth the saving to me. Of course backups blah blah. It still sucks.
[seriousquokka] Prepare to wait weeks as Mwave is undergoing a disastrous backend transition to Shopify. Search recent discussions on reddit.
[Roe Jogan] such retards, they are not able to sync the stock watching software which i assume is old trash to shopify backend, so easily fixable with shopify mcp and claude code
[onyx981] From a decade of working in software, companies like this are allergic to simple fixes and in a constant state of self sabotaging.
[asrey1975] I have an order from 10 Sept still waiting on an update, was also said to be at supplier.. on their website they say 7 days, has been 2 weeks.
[ozbargainhunter400] It's mwave, i'd rather get a divorce than go through mwave's process for a order.
[asrey1975] LOL… I hear you.. could be Christmas before I hear anything back :(
[Fullhalter] Let us divorce our mwives and marry mwave!
[Yve] Been really tilted at Mwave for removing order history and never sending invoices. Wanted to find an invoice for proof of purchase recently and couldn't bc they changed hands and then decided to wipe their website.
[toneypaloney] same, genuinely in this situation what is there to do
[mrfuku] Nope they don’t, only a vague confirmation and payment verification.
For anyone needing invoices jump on their live chat, I was able to get one sent to me within 10 minutes or so.
[4to] Always screenshot everything for every order
[asrey1975] Thanks OP, ordered two. Lets hope they deliver something… anything! I'm.up to $1500 in backlogged orders now with MWAVE..
[Alleviate] Anyone think these orders will be cancelled when you look at Mwave's history?
Haven't seen a 2TB SSD priced like this in a very long time.
[DarnyBoy1982] They are known to do this, then refund you. If nobody else is selling at this price, there is no way Mwave will honour it.
[Alleviate] I've seen lots of reports of them doing this. Surely there will come a time however if they keep doing it they'll get investigated? You're not allowed to keep advertising products with incorrect prices and then refunding them over and over again. You'd have to imagine they'd be investigated for bait and switch advertising.
[DarnyBoy1982] I remember reading a fair trading article years ago that basically outlined that a company doesn't have to honour a pricing error. I don't know if this has since changed.
[Alleviate] @DarnyBoy1982: That's true, however if it happens constantly you could probably argue it becomes more than just a pricing error.
I'm not a lawyer, but the following basically covers it if a business is deliberately engaging in that behaviour (I'm not saying Mwave is definitely doing this, but they've certainly had a few issues lately): https://www.accc.gov.au/consumers/advertising-and-promotions…
[rlytoasti] Pretty good price given how insane storage prices are right now, but just worried about ordering anything from Mwave at the moment.
[rlytoasti] Yeah definitely right. I paid through paypal.
[asrey1975] I just saw them on Amazon for under $1000 each, for 2TB wth? Umart showing out of stock, last price $500 - this is a good deal if they ship!
[Alleviate] Yeah it's nuts. I noticed that as well. Even Umart were selling them over $500.
If this isn't a pricing error it's the deal of the year for SSD's.
[Notbigdeal] Damn good price if you indeed receive it. Had no problem with the brand as it is made in Taiwan.
[scrimshaw] All DRAM kits appear to be in stock at supplier
https://www.mwave.com.au/collections/pc-ddr5
https://www.mwave.com.au/collections/pc-ddr4
In fact there are no "out of stock" items, everything is green text "in stock"
This is highly likely some kind of inventory db glitch, since mwave just updated their website and they also deleted all our customer data (including your address book and invoices — just checked my profile which is close to 10 years old and it's a clean slate). I believe they are going to restore customer data but this will take time according to their Facebook.
[boozed] Shame
mwave must spend more time refunding incorrectly advertised orders than anything else these days
[cevad] I reckon they'd be better off taking the website offline, sorting out their issues and then bringing it back, than just leaving it and having to deal with a whole truckload or 10 of refunds.
[ozbargainhunter400] last time i ordered from them, it was "in stock" and then downgraded weeks later to "at supplier" and then it took 3 months to get a cancellation.
[Alleviate] Considering they are also advertising 32GB DDR5 Ram at $231.95: https://www.mwave.com.au/products/team-tforce-delta-rgb-32gb… I think it's obvious there is a website issue. :(
[cloudie9] Why keep posting MWave deals? They should be banned from OzB. Non existence customer service.
[bart2] fingers crossed theyll refund without us hsving to contact them
[snooker] how did you get in touch. Waiting on my refund from their 5060ti deal. Have attempted to contact them through 4 different means.
[Hornpub] treat nands as golds this days, clearly error.
[Noob Noob] Same…
But on the upside at least we won't have to wait three months for a refund.
[xxJAGUARxx] Anyone snag the RAM DDR5 before the prices went up?
[snooker] Wont be buying from MWAVE again unless its instore.
Purchased their last deal on the 5060ti which they then cancelled stating pricing error.
Am yet to receive a refund and am beginning the process of disputing with my bank. Have attempted to contact them through 4 different means and have received no response
